استدعيا (form X)
# اِسْتَدْعَيَا (istadʕayā) /is.tad.ʕa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَدْعَى (istadʕā)
# اُسْتُدْعِيَا (ustudʕiyā) /us.tud.ʕi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَدْعَى (istadʕā)
# اِسْتَدْعِيَا (istadʕiyā) /is.tad.ʕi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَدْعَى (istadʕā)
